report_path.description: Repository-relative path of the report you saved; must be the path the request names.

approved.description: True only when no finding in the requested scope remains open.

verdict.description: The review skill's verdict, as written in the report.

open_findings.description: Every finding still open in scope, with the report IDs (follow-ups keep the original IDs).

open_questions.description: Open product questions for the user, kept apart from defects.
